# Stockifyy

> Pakistan's premier stock market education and advisory platform. We help retail investors learn technical analysis, understand capital markets, and grow wealth through structured courses and personalized advisory.

## Services

- [Technical Analysis SuperClass](/services/technical-analysis-superclass): Comprehensive course covering chart patterns, indicators, and trading psychology. Taught by Dr. Masood Rashid & Mr. Hassan Askari.
- [Stockifyy Membership](/services/stockifyy-membership): Exclusive members-only access to market insights, trade alerts, and community.
- [One-on-One Advisory](/services/one-on-one-advisory): Personalized investment advisory sessions tailored to your portfolio.
- [Corporate Advisory](/services/corporate-advisory): Strategic financial guidance for businesses and institutions.
- [Assets Under Advisement Model](/services/assets-under-advisement-model): Managed advisory for larger portfolios.

## About

Stockifyy was founded to democratize stock market education in Pakistan. Our instructors have decades of combined experience in capital markets, technical analysis, and wealth management.
